edits.value: Use this when you did not witness the state yourself — you heard it from someone else, read it, or are inferring it from evidence. It is often translated as «apparently», «reportedly», or «I hear that». It has no tense: without a time word, hastaymış usually means «apparently she is ill»; with dün («yesterday») it means «apparently she was ill».
